acceptance_criteria.text: Repeating instances of elements in the same position are ordered numerically when their name strings match up to the "#" character (both ascending and descending sort order).
acceptance_criteria.source_quote: When displaying the mechanical structure as a tree, repeating instances of elements in the same position are ordered numerically if there name strings match up until the "#" character.
test_ids: sorts repeating instances with matching base name in ascending numerical order (#2 before #10)
sorts repeating instances with matching base name in descending numerical order (#10 before #2)
falls back to alphabetical order when base names do not match up to the # character

findings.summary: compareInstanceNumbers/getBaseNameFromLabel do exact-string base-name matching with no case normalization, so labels differing only by case (e.g. 'bg30#2' vs 'BG30#10') fall through to the localeCompare fallback instead of numeric ordering. Not required by AC1's wording ('name strings match') and no evidence real instance labels vary in case (getInstanceLabel always builds them from the same 'name' attribute), so this is a theoretical edge case rather than an observed defect.
